_about: What JPL's tables don't give, from the published literature (each entry's _source). build_solar.py lays each entry over the body. Orbits are J2000 ecliptic Keplerian elements: a_km, e, i, node, peri, meanAnomaly in degrees, and epochJD.

Hiʻiaka._source: Ragozzine & Brown 2009, AJ 137:4766: orbit and mass. Size from Fraser & Brown 2009's estimate, roughly.

Namaka._source: Ragozzine & Brown 2009, AJ 137:4766: orbit and mass. Size estimated from its brightness relative to Haumea's.

Weywot._source: Proudfoot et al. 2025, PSJ, 'Beyond Point Masses V', constrained fit (J2000 ecliptic): orbit. Size roughly from its occultations.

Quaoar._source: Braga-Ribas et al. 2013, ApJ 773:26 (radius from its occultation); Fraser et al. 2013, Icarus 222:357 (mass from Weywot's orbit).

Sedna._source: Pál et al. 2012, A&A 541:L6 (995 km across, thermal).

Gonggong._source: Kiss et al. 2019, Icarus 334:3 (1230 km across).

90482Orcus._source: Thermal measurements, 'TNOs are Cool' (Stansberry et al. 2012; Fornasier et al. 2013; Vilenius et al. 2014; Lellouch et al. 2013).
